en.answer: Even if a face-down Defense Position <<12108>> is destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effect, you can activate its second effect.
en.question: If a face-down Defense Position <<12108>> is destroyed by my opponent's <<4342>>, can I activate the effect that Special Summons a "Burning Abyss" monster from my Extra Deck? Also, if a face-down Defense Position <<12108>> is attacked, flipped face-up, and destroyed by battle, can I activate the effect that Special Summons a "Burning Abyss" monster from my Extra Deck?
